alternate_integrator.agreement_rule: For every primary-map run, D(RK4 dt/4, DOP853) <= max(1e-5, 10*D(RK4 dt/2, RK4 dt/4)).
alternate_integrator.projected_policy: Integrate in 0.001 segments and apply the same radial retraction at each segment boundary for MP and MFP.

authorization.condition: All lock hashes, software tests, and pre-execution tripwires must pass.

failure_and_missing_policy.direction_completeness: all five c0 configurations and both compared models must pass all mandatory numerical gates
pilot_stop_rules: Stop immediately on code-equation parity failure, lock mismatch, mislabeled split, or permutation tripwire failure.
Pause and diagnose if more than 10% of pilot configurations fail numerical gates.
Do not relax thresholds after viewing effects.
failure_and_missing_policy.primary_decision_block: More than one failed confirmatory direction, any identity-gate failure, any invariant tripwire failure, or any lock mismatch forces INCONCLUSIVE/INVALID.

inferential_design.model_random_seeds: none; dynamics and configurations are deterministic
inferential_design.secondary_multiplicity: Secondary endpoints are developmental and cannot promote claims. Report 98.75% percentile intervals for H2-H4 and geometry outcomes as a four-family Bonferroni descriptive safeguard.

metrics.direction_numerical_floor: maximum, over the five c0 configurations and both compared models, of RK4 dt/2-vs-dt/4 trajectory discrepancy and RK4 dt/4-vs-DOP853 discrepancy

numerical_acceptance.rk4_refinement_ordering: D(dt/2,dt/4) < D(dt,dt/2) for every frozen observation map used in a decision.
numerical_acceptance.singular_policy: fail closed; no clipping, pseudoinverse, or fallback

mechanism.definition: F0, FF, combined proposal, projection correction, constraint residual, normalized tangency residual, denominator, and retraction diagnostics

pilot_confirmatory_separation.amendment_rule: A substantive metric, threshold, model, parameter, or configuration change creates protocol v1.1+ and requires a fresh unexecuted confirmatory split.
pilot_confirmatory_separation.confirmatory_access: No confirmatory trajectory may be generated during Phase 6 pilot.

primary_hypothesis.config_effect: trajectory metric for one direction and c0 configuration
primary_hypothesis.negative_rule: EQUIVALENT_WITHIN_PROTOCOL_MARGIN only if the upper 95% bootstrap bound is below 0.002, every direction effect is below 0.002, and every direction numerical floor is below 0.002/3.
primary_hypothesis.positive_rule: DETECTED only if the lower 95% bootstrap bound exceeds 0.02 and at least 80% of direction effects exceed 0.02 and are at least 10 times their direction numerical floor.
primary_hypothesis.question: Are collective feedback (MF) and constant-amplitude projection (MP) dynamically distinguishable under the full-state observation map over the frozen confirmatory domain?
primary_hypothesis.scope: Any result is restricted to contract v1.0, the frozen parameter set, T=10, the declared observation map, and the initial-condition domain.

uncertainty.interpretation: design-distribution uncertainty over the frozen direction set, not population sampling uncertainty

primary_hypothesis.unit_effect: median of the five c0 config effects within one direction

provenance.raw_output_policy: immutable; summaries are derived and must name all input hashes

secondary_hypotheses.claim_level: developmental secondary; cannot promote a scientific claim
secondary_hypotheses.prediction: Same-state node derivatives agree, but retained s/q feedback produces later node-trajectory divergence.
Collective feedback produces a trajectory difference above numerical error.
Projection produces a trajectory difference above numerical error while preserving the constraint.

secondary_hypotheses.gate: mandatory; any violation invalidates the affected run and blocks claim promotion
secondary_hypotheses.prediction: Post-retraction residual remains within the frozen contract tolerance for every accepted run.

secondary_hypotheses.gate: mandatory; any violation stops the pilot
secondary_hypotheses.prediction: Evaluating MP and MFP at the same recorded regular full state gives node derivatives equal within 1e-12 normalized error.
